name: Born With Quick Feet
effect: AGI and COD cost 15% less during creation and future Player-XP upgrades.
why_it_costs_that: Useful but not a premier QB rating pair.

name: Naturally Fast
effect: SPD and ACC cost 12% less during creation and future upgrades.
why_it_costs_that: Speed/acceleration are extremely valuable and expensive.

name: Explosive First Step
effect: ACC costs 18% less during creation and future upgrades.

name: Natural Athlete
effect: AGI, COD, JMP and ACC each cost 8% less.

name: Born With an Arm
effect: THP costs 15% less.
why_it_costs_that: Throw power is a premium QB attribute.

name: Natural Accuracy
effect: SAC and MAC cost 10% less; DAC costs 6% less.

name: Pocket Sense
effect: BSK costs 15% less and TUP costs 8% less.
why_it_costs_that: Improves pocket survival without raw speed.

name: Off-Platform Thrower
effect: TOR costs 15% less and TUP 8% less.

name: Play-Action Savant
effect: PAC costs 18% less.

name: Deep Ball Artist
effect: DAC costs 12% less and THP 6% less.
why_it_costs_that: Cascades with Born With an Arm for vertical QBs; discount cap still applies.

name: Rhythm Passer
effect: SAC and MAC each cost 8% less.
why_it_costs_that: Smaller accuracy discount than Natural Accuracy.

name: Pressure Proof
effect: TUP costs 18% less. Gold weekly challenges completed with 0 turnovers grant +1 bonus XP.
why_it_costs_that: Premium due to attribute + XP component.

name: Escape Artist
effect: BSK, COD and ACC each cost 10% less.

name: Designed Runner
effect: CAR, JKM and BCV each cost 10% less.

name: Ball Security
effect: CAR costs 18% less.

name: Clutch Processor
effect: AWR upgrades cost 10% less; playoff weekly challenge XP +20%.

name: Command at the Line
effect: If the player earns 120+ IQ, his first AWR upgrade each season costs 25% less XP.
why_it_costs_that: Conditional IQ synergy keeps it from being universally optimal.

name: Two-Minute Specialist
effect: Weekly challenges involving completion percentage, zero turnovers, or passing TDs pay +1 XP when completed in a win, max +1/week.

name: Faster Developer
effect: Earn +15% Player XP from all eligible sources. Dev-trait promotion challenge checks occur 50% more often until the player reaches X-Factor. Does not guarantee promotion; the challenge still must be completed.
why_it_costs_that: Directly accelerates both ratings growth and access to development promotions, so it consumes half the build.

name: Team Player
effect: Team XP functionality is unlocked from Season 1. The player may convert his earned Player XP to Team XP at the normal 4:3 rate even before reaching his personal ceiling. XP already spent on teammates cannot be reclaimed.
why_it_costs_that: Creates roster-wide value years earlier than normal.

name: Great Negotiator
effect: All REC Coin contract offers are increased by 20% after the normal contract-value calculation. Applies to Contracts II and III; Rookie Contract remains draft-slot based unless league configuration enables rookie negotiation bonuses.

name: Known Commodity
effect: For Contracts II and III, the player's performance component can never produce an offer below the 'Elite' salary band. The contract engine values him as an established ceiling-level asset even after a poor contract window.
why_it_costs_that: Removes most downside risk from the career economy.

name: Competitive Drive
effect: Completing all three issued weekly challenges grants +2 bonus Player XP, once per league week.
why_it_costs_that: Requires performance rather than granting passive ratings.

name: Film Junkie
effect: Future AWR upgrades cost 20% less Player XP. Defensive players also receive 20% cheaper PRC upgrades. Does not change IQ-test results.
why_it_costs_that: Permanent discount on highly valuable mental attributes.

name: Generational Ceiling
effect: Starting development trait is Star rather than Normal. The player is eligible for future Superstar/X-Factor promotion challenges through performance. No direct ratings are added.
